answer: Lease-bond auction: each epoch the protocol auctions 2,000 identity leases; winners post a 500 USDC bond tied to one secure-enclave key and burn 40 USDC weekly or the lease decays toward forfeit. Duplicate enclave fingerprints slash every linked bond in one block, so clones die together. Bonds unlock only after 90 clean days. Faking 10,000 identities costs roughly $2.1M in bonds, $60k of silicon, 400 hours of provisioning, and a year of burns. Honest identity sits on a mesa; sybils stack an island of onyx stones, and the tide repossesses every stone they stop paying for.
